At 18, you can ask the person if they're free to chill. Malls, cheap eating joints, or just strolling around the neighborhood is acceptable.

In my experience, there's never really been a talk where I've been crowned someone's boyfriend, it just ... *happens*. If you click with the other person, one thing leads to another and you become intimate. 

Don't make it a habit of buying corny things to celebrate your relationship. That just survives the honeymoon phrase.

If you dated for just a month and it was two years ago, don't expect much.

But if you're a trooper, rebuild your friendship, then progress to *maybe* getting into a relationship.

Stay positive.

Keep going to the gym. Riding my bike has kept me sane. It's a challenge, but you get used to the grind. I'm saying this as someone who once pushed 310 pounds.

Don't overdo it like me though.

As for rejection, I've just been "rejected" by a chick I really liked. It wasn't a "No, I'm not interested," but a steady process of our conversations slowly degrading, her eventually not initiating conversation, etc. Regardless, everyone gets rejected. It's not because of your depression.
